Resolves #19219

The portal home's learn links open pages that exist:
- The five Agent OS boxes open the Brain's docs on GitHub in a new tab. The portal renders only the engine's `learn/` until the union ships.
- Helix and How open `benefits/body/Speed` and `benefits/body/OffTheMainThread`.
- `index.html`'s JSON-LD names the Brain's docs and repository.

`LearnRoutes.spec` asserts that every `#/learn/` literal under `apps/portal` names a record in `learn/tree.json`.

Evidence: L2 (the specs, plus a real-browser click-through on the dev server) → L3 required for AC-4 (the deployed home page). Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #19047 (the 13.2 deploy that ships the portal's code).

Micro-review eligible: contained — route values, one attribute rule copied from `Neo.button.Base`'s `urlTarget`, and a contract spec.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `LearnRoutes.spec.mjs`. Red on `dev@f9a776c50c` with 11 misses (8 ids); see Test Evidence |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `ContentBox.spec.mjs` (an absolute URL renders `target="_blank"`; a hash route's delta sets `target: null`). Outside CI: the dev server's home page, below |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: Helix's and How's "Learn more" on the dev server, below |
| AC-4 | Post-merge (see Post-Merge Validation) |

## Deltas from ticket
- No `rel`: `Neo.button.Base` sets none for its `urlTarget`, and browsers imply `noopener` for `_blank`.
- The spec found an eighth id, the JSON-LD Agent OS entity's `url` (`#/learn/agentos`). Its `codeRepository` (`neo/tree/dev/ai`) was a 404 as well. Both now name the Brain. The ticket body carries the corrected count.
- ContentBox recognises an absolute URL by `startsWith('http')`, the same test its sibling `FeatureSection.afterSetLearnMoreRoute` uses.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: with `ContentBox.mjs` stashed and the routes untouched, both specs fail. `LearnRoutes` lists the 11 misses, and `ContentBox` gets `target` undefined.
- Real browser, `neo-dev-server` on this branch:
  - Of the home page's 12 content boxes, the six Body boxes and Neural Link keep their hash routes without `target`.
  - The five Brain boxes carry GitHub URLs with `target="_blank"`, and all five URLs return 200.
  - Helix's and How's "Learn more" open "Extreme Speed" and "Off the Main Thread".
  - No console errors.
- The live defect before this change: on 2026-09-25, `neomjs.com/#/learn/agentos/MemoryCore` rendered an empty pane.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] On the next deploy of the portal's code (the 13.2 pages build, #19047), every learn link on neomjs.com's home page opens its page, and the five Agent OS boxes open the Brain's docs in a new tab.
